header.title: [XX-GEM Strategy-XX]
header.subtitle: [XX-Global equities momentum – equities versus a safe asset-XX]
header.explainer: [XX-Global Equities Momentum allocates the whole strategy portfolio to a single asset each period: equities when their {months}-month return beats the risk-free asset (absolute momentum), otherwise the safe asset. Among equities, the market with the strongest {months}-month return wins (relative momentum).-XX]

scenarios.createHint: [XX-A second scenario lets you run the same rules another way — a shorter momentum window, a quarterly cadence, a different set of instruments — and compare them once both have evaluated.-XX]
scenarios.deleteMessage: [XX-{name} will be removed with its role assignments and its whole evaluation history. The history cannot be rebuilt: it records the momentum figures each past decision was taken on.-XX]

stale.updating: [XX-Updating — the figures below are from the previous selection-XX]

roleDescriptions.US_EQUITY: [XX-US large caps. Its return is the one the absolute-momentum test measures against the risk-free benchmark.-XX]
roleDescriptions.EX_US_EQUITY: [XX-Developed markets outside the US — Europe, Japan, Canada, Australia. Competes with the other two equity legs in the ranking.-XX]
roleDescriptions.EM_EQUITY: [XX-Emerging markets — China, India, Taiwan, Brazil and the rest. Competes with the other two equity legs in the ranking.-XX]
roleDescriptions.SAFE: [XX-Held while RISK-OFF (e.g. an aggregate bond ETF).-XX]
roleDescriptions.RISK_FREE: [XX-Optional. The yardstick the absolute-momentum test measures equities against (e.g. T-bills). Left empty, the safe asset is used.-XX]
